The nine `input.sh` and `expected.json` pairs are unchanged files from pinned
ImGui-Terminal commit `1a6733ba9e5cd777acc86cbb111c1c9b4f7500a4`, under ned's
recorded upstream revision. `output.bin` captures each script's Bash printf
output with the original Unix PTY's ONLCR conversion (LF becomes CRLF). Core
checks feed those bytes in arbitrary three-byte chunks. Renderer tests compare
all unchanged cached drawing operations, not just the visible text.

`state.json` adds twelve cases and 54 transitions generated by the unchanged
original `Terminal` methods: alternate screens and saved attributes; truncating
both grids and keeping the cursor visible on resize; tabs and pending wrap;
CJK, emoji, combining marks, VS15/VS16 and one-column screens; erase colors;
blink attributes, mouse/input modes and RIS; word/line/rectangular selections;
selection scrolling and overwrite; scrolling regions and origin coordinates;
DEC character sets and repeating after control characters; X11 color names,
palette mutation/reset/query, title semantics and PTY replies.

Regenerate with `bash scripts/provenance/update-terminal-fixtures.sh`. The apparatus
exposes private state solely for measurement and calls original methods; it
replaces no terminal algorithm. Font loading and PTY startup are not required
for these core leaf comparisons. Replies are captured through a real pipe.
The original translation unit and ImGui sources remain unchanged. Both the
submodule SHA and clean source status are checked.

Compiling the original translation unit requires genuine Fontconfig headers,
even though its unused font loader is removed by the native linker's section
collector. The fixture uses Fontconfig 2.17.1's header template and license:

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arthenica/fontconfig/2.17.1/fontconfig/fontconfig.h.in
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arthenica/fontconfig/2.17.1/COPYING

Put those files into `reference/deps/fontconfig/`. The generator verifies the
header's SHA-256 `5e5e2494b98b4ca691165dd166732e96beb6a25d757a9251553561d2fc4fd321`
and substitutes `@CACHE_VERSION@` with `9`, exactly as the pinned release's
`meson.build` specifies. No Fontconfig API or implementation is substituted.
Fontconfig's copyright/license notice remains embedded in its header.

The terminal adapter and translated fixtures are attributed under
`LICENSES/terminal-adapter-BSL-1.1.txt` (Neal Mick's Terminal Adapter BSL 1.1, including
its retained st MIT notice). These core/drawing fixtures complement the real
PTY and input automation tests; they do not replace native application/GPU
captures or Linux/Windows acceptance.

This optional generator requires the ignored pinned source checkout described
in `scripts/provenance/README.md`. Bed builds and ordinary terminal tests use
the committed fixtures without compiling the original terminal or a reference checkout.
